passage:
Class 806 made a recipe book for a cultural festival. Each student brought one family recipe and wrote a short story about it.
Some recipes were simple, like fried eggs with tomatoes. Others took many hours. One student wrote about dumplings made every New Year. Another wrote about soup his father cooked when someone was sick.
The class did not cook every dish, but they read the stories aloud.
The recipe book became popular because it was not only about food. It was about memory, family, and care.
A recipe tells people how to make something. A story tells them why it matters.
